## What's Changed
* Show what the model-backed flows are doing while they wait by @navbytes in https://github.com/navbytes/opencode-tree/pull/12
* Publish prereleases under the beta dist-tag by @navbytes in https://github.com/navbytes/opencode-tree/pull/13
* Ask OpenCode for a frame when the status line changes (0.3.0-beta.2) by @navbytes in https://github.com/navbytes/opencode-tree/pull/14
* Open only the current turn by default, not the last three by @navbytes in https://github.com/navbytes/opencode-tree/pull/15
* Name the key on the row that needs it, and stop hardcoding keys by @navbytes in https://github.com/navbytes/opencode-tree/pull/16
* Move the fold marker left, and make the ? pane's keys the bright thing by @navbytes in https://github.com/navbytes/opencode-tree/pull/17
* Changelog: today's release is 0.3.0 by @navbytes in https://github.com/navbytes/opencode-tree/pull/18


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/navbytes/opencode-tree/compare/v0.2.7...v0.3.0
